requirements.name: Address (National)
requirements.description: A valid, real-world physical address located in the same country as the phone number being purchased. The address must include street name and number, postal or ZIP code, city, region or province (where applicable), and country. The address does not need to match the specific city or area code of the number; any address within the national borders is acceptable. P.O. boxes, virtual office addresses, mailbox-only services, and addresses outside the country of the phone number are not acceptable. The address should match the address shown on supporting identity or business registration documents where those are also required.
requirements.example: For a Spanish phone number: Calle de Alcalá 42, 28014 Madrid, Spain. For a German phone number: Friedrichstraße 123, 10117 Berlin, Germany. The address must be a deliverable physical location, not a P.O. box or virtual mailbox.

requirements.name: Contact Information (Name, Business Name, Phone Number)
requirements.description: Contact information for the business or end user, including: (1) the name of the contact person (full given name and family name), (2) the business name when the end user is a business (registered   legal name where applicable; may be omitted or stated as 'N/A' for individual end users), and (3) one or more contact phone numbers where the business or end user can be reached. Contact person name and at least one phone number are mandatory; business name is required only when the end user is a business entity. Phone numbers should be in international E.164 format where possible.
requirements.example: Contact: Maria García López | Business: Bloom & Petal Florist Ltd. | Phone: +34 612 345 678. For individual end users: Contact: John Smith | Business: N/A | Phone: +1 (555) 123-4567.

requirements.name: Proof of Address (Local), with Local Activity Evidence
requirements.description: Provide a document dated within the past 3 months that shows the supplied local service address in the country of the phone number. Accepted documents include bank statements, government letters, tax letters, invoices, bills, utility bills, or other official documents that verify the end user’s local address.  The document must show the individual’s name for personal end users, or the business name for business end users. Bank statements are an acceptable form of address verification when they show the required name, local service address, issuer, and date within the past 3 months.  Leases, rental agreements, or other documents with occupancy or contract terms are not accepted.
requirements.example: A recent bank statement, government letter, tax notice, invoice, bill, or utility bill showing the individual’s name or business name and the supplied local service address, dated within the past 90 days.

requirements.name: Contact Information (Name, Business Name, Phone Number)
requirements.description: Contact information for the business or end user, including: (1) the name of the contact person (full given name and family name), (2) the business name when the end user is a business (registered   legal name where applicable; may be omitted or stated as 'N/A' for individual end users), and (3) one or more contact phone numbers where the business or end user can be reached. Contact person name and at least one phone number are mandatory; business name is required only when the end user is a business entity. requirements.example: Contact: Maria García López | Business: Bloom & Petal Florist Ltd. | Phone: +34 612 345 678. For individual end users: Contact: John Smith | Business: N/A | Phone: +1 (555) 123-4567.

requirements.name: Recent Proof of Address (Worldwide), Within 3 Months
requirements.description: A document evidencing the customer's physical address, issued within the past 3 months. The address may be located in any country in the world; this requirement does NOT impose a country match with the phone number. Acceptable documents include utility bills (electricity, water, gas, internet, landline telephone), bank statements, tax notices, government correspondence, or insurance documents. The document must clearly show (1) the full name of the individual or registered business name, (2) the complete physical address, and (3) the document issue date. Mobile phone bills, screenshots, and bills older than 3 months are not acceptable.
requirements.example: A PDF of a utility bill (e.g., from any electricity, water, gas, internet, or landline provider in the customer's country) addressed to the customer at their physical address, with an issue date within the past 90 days.

requirements.name: Worldwide Physical Address
requirements.description: A valid, real-world physical address located anywhere in the world. Must include street name and number, postal code (where applicable), city, region or province (where applicable), and country. The address provided must correspond to a validated physical address (e.g., as enriched via address validation in the Telnyx system). P.O. boxes, virtual office addresses, and mailbox-only services may not be acceptable depending on the order's downstream country requirements; a deliverable physical location is preferred.
requirements.example: 123 Main St, Brooklyn, NY 11217, US. Or: 60 Holborn Viaduct, London EC1A 2FD, United Kingdom. The address can be in any country in the world but must be a real, deliverable physical location.

requirements.name: Passport or Government-Issued ID Copy (End User or Authorized Representative)
requirements.description: A clear color copy of a valid, unexpired government-issued identity document for the end user (for personal accounts) or the authorized representative of the company (for business accounts). Acceptable documents are the biographical data page of a passport, a national identity card (front and back), or, where local rules permit, a driver's license. The copy must legibly show the holder's full legal name, photograph, date of birth, document number, issuing country and authority, issue date, and expiration date. The document must not be expired as of the submission date and must be a color scan or original PDF. Black-and-white copies, photographs at extreme angles, and screenshots of digital wallet IDs are not acceptable.
requirements.example: A color PDF of the biographical data page of a U.S. passport, or a color scan of both sides of a French Carte Nationale d'Identité. The holder's name on the document must match the name provided in the order's customer or representative fields.

requirements.name: Proof of Address (National), Recent Utility Bill or Invoice
requirements.description: A document evidencing the customer's physical address within the same country as the phone number being purchased, dated within the past 3 months. Acceptable documents include utility bills (electricity, water, gas, internet, landline telephone), bank statements, tax notices, or government-issued correspondence. The document must clearly show (1) the full name of the individual or registered business name, (2) the complete physical address (street, postal code, city, country), and (3) the document issue date. The document must be submitted as a PDF or clear color scan. Screenshots, handwritten documents, mobile phone bills (when not the proof of residence), and bills older than 3 months are not acceptable.
requirements.example: A PDF of an Iberdrola electricity bill dated within the last 90 days, addressed to the customer at a Spanish residential address, for a Spain phone number order. The bill must show the customer's name, full service address, and the issuer's logo and billing date.

requirements.name: List of In-Service Australian Mobile Numbers (Purchaser Disclosure)
requirements.description: A list of all other activated prepaid mobile carriage services (Australian mobile numbers) currently supplied to the same Purchaser, as required by Australian regulations. If the Purchaser has no other in-service prepaid Australian mobile numbers, the response should clearly state 'None'. Numbers must be in international E.164 format starting with +61 followed by 9 digits. Australian mobile numbers begin with +614.
requirements.example: +61412345678, +61423456789, +61434567890. Or, if the Purchaser has no other in-service AU mobile numbers: 'None'. Numbers must be in +61 international format.

requirements.name: Purchaser or Service Activator Confirmation (AU Mobile)
requirements.description: Confirmation, required by Australian regulations, of whether the end user is the Purchaser or the Service Activator of the prepaid mobile carriage service. PURCHASER means the individual who pays for the service during the sale transaction (or, where a carriage service provider extends a free invitation, the person who accepts the invitation). SERVICE ACTIVATOR means the person who requests activation of a prepaid mobile carriage service from the offering carriage service provider. The submitted value must clearly indicate one of the two roles.
requirements.example: Purchaser (the individual who paid for the prepaid SIM at the point of sale). Or: Service Activator (the individual who activated the prepaid service via the carrier's portal or activation line).

requirements.name: Australian Mobile ID Verification (Onfido Process)
requirements.description: An identity verification process required for Australian Mobile DIDs, conducted via Telnyx's partner Onfido. The customer (or Telnyx on the customer's behalf) generates a unique verification link and shares it with the end user. The end user accesses Onfido's secure portal via the link, uploads government-issued identification documents, and completes a real-time selfie/liveness check. The Telnyx team reviews the verification result; if Onfido approves and the documents pass review, this requirement is marked complete. This is an action-type requirement: no document is uploaded directly by the customer; the verification is completed via the Onfido flow.
requirements.example: Generate an Onfido verification link via Telnyx and provide it to the end user. The end user uploads their Australian government-issued ID and completes a liveness selfie. The verification status updates automatically once Onfido completes its checks and the Telnyx team reviews the result.

requirements.name: End User Date of Birth (ISO 8601 Format)
requirements.description: The end user's full date of birth, submitted in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). The value must be a real calendar date, must indicate the person is at least 18 years old as of the submission date, and must match the date of birth shown on any accompanying identity document. Future dates and dates implying the person is a minor are not acceptable.
requirements.example: 2002-06-15 (June 15, 2002). The format must be exactly four-digit year, two-digit month, two-digit day, separated by hyphens. Formats such as 06/15/2002, 15-06-2002, or 'June 15 2002' are not acceptable.

requirements.name: Local Business Registration Certificate (Business Use Only)
requirements.description: An official company registration or incorporation certificate issued by the government registry of the same country as the phone number being purchased. Required for business end users only. The document must clearly show the registered legal company name (matching the order), the unique company registration or incorporation number, the date of registration, the registered business address, and the issuing authority. Should be a clear color scan or original PDF in the local language or English, dated within the past 3 months unless a different timeframe applies at the country level.
requirements.example: For a France phone number: an Extrait Kbis from the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce. For a UK phone number: a Companies House Certificate of Incorporation. The certificate must display the legal company name, registration number, registration date, and registered office address.

requirements.name: Local Government-Issued ID or Passport Copy (issued by country of phone number)

Acceptable documents include a national identity card (front and back) or the biographical data page of a passport. The copy must clearly display the holder's full legal name, photograph, date of birth, document number, issuing authority, issue date, and expiration date. Documents issued by countries other than the order's country are not accepted under this requirement.
requirements.example: A color scan of a Spanish DNI (front and back) for a Spain phone number order, a French Carte Nationale d'Identité for a France order, or the photo and data page of a German Reisepass for a Germany order. All security features and personal details must be legible, and the document must not be expired as of the submission date.

Addresses outside the area code's geographic region are not acceptable for this requirement; a different (broader, national-level) address requirement must be selected if the customer cannot provide a matching local address.
requirements.example: 311 W Superior St, Chicago, IL 60654 (matches Chicago area code 312). For a +44 20 (Greater London) DID: an address within Greater London such as '60 Holborn Viaduct, London EC1A 2FD'. The address must lie within the area code's geographic boundaries.

requirements.name: Recently Signed Letter of Intent (LOI) Within 1 Month
requirements.description: A signed Letter of Intent (LOI) executed by the end user or their authorized representative within 1 month of the order being placed. requirements.example: A PDF Letter of Intent signed by the authorized representative within the past 30 days, listing the phone numbers being requested or ported, the customer's legal name, the signing date, and the representative's signature.

requirements.name: Company Name (Full Legal Name)
requirements.description: The full legal name of the company associated with the phone number, exactly as registered with the relevant national company registry. The name must include any legal suffix such as 'LLC', 'Ltd.', 'GmbH', 'S.A.', 'S.r.l.', or equivalent. Maximum 150 characters, minimum 1 character. Trade names and informal abbreviations without legal status are not acceptable; the registered legal name is required.
requirements.example: Telnyx LLC, Acme Florist Limited, Bloom & Petal GmbH, or Empresa Ejemplo S.A. The submitted name must match the company's official registration certificate; informal trading names ('Acme', 'Bloom') without the legal suffix are not acceptable.

requirements.description: An official tax certificate issued by the relevant national tax authority of the same country as the phone number, confirming the entity's tax registration status. The certificate must show the registered business name (matching the order), the assigned tax identification number, the country of issuance, the registration date, and the issuing authority. Certificates from countries other than the phone number's country are not acceptable for this requirement.
requirements.example: A VAT registration certificate from HMRC (for UK numbers), a Vergi Levhası from the Turkish Revenue Administration (for Turkish numbers), or an equivalent certificate from the country's national tax authority showing the business name and tax ID.

The document must show the registered legal company name (matching the order), the incorporation or registration number, the date of incorporation, the registered office address in the country, and the issuing authority. Certificates of Incorporation from countries other than the phone number's country are not acceptable for this requirement.

requirements.name: Contact Email Address of End Client
requirements.description: A valid email address for the end client (the natural person or business that will use the phone number), used for compliance follow-up. The submitted value must be a syntactically valid email address (max 150 characters) and should reach the end client directly. Generic or shared role-based addresses (e.g., info@, contact@) are acceptable but a personal address tied to the named end client is preferred.
requirements.example: maria.garcia@bloomandpetal.com or contact@acme-coffee.de. The address must be syntactically valid (matching the standard email format) and should be a working address.

requirements.name: Latest Trade License (In-Country)
requirements.description: The most recent Trade License issued by the relevant national or municipal authority of the same country as the phone number, authorizing the business to conduct trade in that jurisdiction. The license must show the registered business name (matching the order), the trade license number, the registered business address in the country, the licensed business activities, and the issuance and expiration dates. The license must not be expired as of the submission date. Trade licenses from countries other than the phone number's country are not acceptable.
requirements.example: A Dubai Trade License from the UAE Department of Economic Development showing the company name, trade license number, registered Dubai address, business activities, and a valid (unexpired) expiration date.

requirements.name: Latest Income Tax Clearance Certificate (In-Country)

The certificate must show the registered business name (matching the order), the tax identification number, the country of issuance, and the issuance date. The certificate should be the most recently issued one available; certificates older than 12 months may not be acceptable depending on local rules.
requirements.example: An Income Tax Clearance Certificate from the relevant national tax authority (e.g., the Federal Tax Authority in the UAE, or the Inland Revenue Department in Hong Kong) showing the business name, tax ID, and issuance date within the past 12 months.

The document must show the registered business name, the complete physical address (street, postal code, city, country) exactly matching the Business Registration Certificate, and an issue date within the past 3 months. Mobile phone bills, screenshots, and personal addresses are not acceptable.
requirements.example: An electricity utility bill addressed to 'Acme GmbH' at 'Friedrichstraße 123, 10117 Berlin, Germany', with an issue date within the past 90 days, where the address exactly matches the address shown on Acme GmbH's Handelsregisterauszug.

requirements.name: Company Registration Certificate (Local Language or English)
requirements.description: A copy of the company registration or incorporation certificate for the company placing the order. The certificate does not need to be issued in the same country as the phone number being ordered. The document is acceptable as long as it is issued by a recognized company registrar in the country where the company is registered and is written either in English or in the local language of the country of company registration.  The document must show the registered legal company name matching the order, the unique registration or incorporation number, the date of registration, the registered business address, and the issuing authority. Submitted as a clear color scan or original PDF.
requirements.example: A Companies House certificate (UK, in English), a Handelsregisterauszug (Germany, in German), or an Extrait Kbis (France, in French), each showing the company's legal name, registration number, registration date, and registered office address.

requirements.name: Worldwide Physical Address
requirements.description: A valid, real-world physical address located anywhere in the world. Must include street name and number, postal code (where applicable), city, region or province (where applicable), and country. The address provided must correspond to a validated physical address (e.g., as enriched via address validation in the Telnyx system). P.O. boxes, virtual office addresses, and mailbox-only services may not be acceptable depending on the order's downstream country requirements; a deliverable physical location is preferred.
requirements.example: 123 Main St, Brooklyn, NY 11217, US. Or: 60 Holborn Viaduct, London EC1A 2FD, United Kingdom. The address can be in any country in the world but must be a real, deliverable physical location.

requirements.name: Passport or Government-Issued ID Copy (End User or Authorized Representative)
requirements.description: A clear color copy of a valid, unexpired government-issued identity document for the end user (for personal accounts) or the authorized representative of the company (for business accounts). Acceptable documents are the biographical data page of a passport, a national identity card (front and back), or, where local rules permit, a driver's license. The copy must legibly show the holder's full legal name, photograph, date of birth, document number, issuing country and authority, issue date, and expiration date. The document must not be expired as of the submission date and must be a color scan or original PDF. Black-and-white copies, photographs at extreme angles, and screenshots of digital wallet IDs are not acceptable.
requirements.example: A color PDF of the biographical data page of a U.S. passport, or a color scan of both sides of a French Carte Nationale d'Identité. The holder's name on the document must match the name provided in the order's customer or representative fields.

requirements.name: Contact Information (Name, Business Name, Phone Number)
requirements.description: Contact information for the business or end user, including: (1) the name of the contact person (full given name and family name), (2) the business name when the end user is a business (registered   legal name where applicable; may be omitted or stated as 'N/A' for individual end users), and (3) one or more contact phone numbers where the business or end user can be reached. Contact person name and at least one phone number are mandatory; business name is required only when the end user is a business entity. Phone numbers should be in international E.164 format where possible.
requirements.example: Contact: Maria García López | Business: Bloom & Petal Florist Ltd. | Phone: +34 612 345 678. For individual end users: Contact: John Smith | Business: N/A | Phone: +1 (555) 123-4567.

requirements.name: Local Business Registration Certificate (Business Use Only)

Should be a clear color scan or original PDF in the local language or English, dated within the past 3 months unless a different timeframe applies at the country level.

The certificate must display the legal company name, registration number, registration date, and registered office address.

requirements.name: Proof of Address (Local), with Local Activity Evidence
requirements.description: Provide a document dated within the past 3 months that shows the supplied local service address in the country of the phone number. Accepted documents include bank statements, government letters, tax letters, invoices, bills, utility bills, or other official documents that verify the end user’s local address.  The document must show the individual’s name for personal end users, or the business name for business end users. Bank statements are an acceptable form of address verification when they show the required name, local service address, issuer, and date within the past 3 months.  Leases, rental agreements, or other documents with occupancy or contract terms are not accepted.
requirements.example: A recent bank statement, government letter, tax notice, invoice, bill, or utility bill showing the individual’s name or business name and the supplied local service address, dated within the past 90 days.

requirements.name: Address Matching the DID Area Code (Geographic Match)
requirements.description: A physical address that matches the geographic area covered by the phone number's area code. The address must include street name and number, postal/ZIP code, city, and country, and the city/region of the address must fall within the geographic area assigned to the DID's area code. Addresses outside the area code's geographic region are not acceptable for this requirement; a different (broader, national-level) address requirement must be selected if the customer cannot provide a matching local address.
requirements.example: 311 W Superior St, Chicago, IL 60654 (matches Chicago area code 312). For a +44 20 (Greater London) DID: an address within Greater London such as '60 Holborn Viaduct, London EC1A 2FD'. The address must lie within the area code's geographic boundaries.

requirements.name: Passport or ID Copy in PDF Format

For ID cards, both front and back must be included in the PDF. The PDF must clearly show the holder's full legal name, photograph, date of birth, document number, issuing authority, and expiration date. The document must not be expired as of the submission date. Image formats other than PDF (such as JPG or PNG) and black-and-white copies are not acceptable for this requirement.

requirements.name: Belgian VAT Number

The submitted value must follow the format 'BE' followed by 10 digits, where the first digit is 0 or 1. The VAT number must correspond to the business named on the order. Belgian VAT numbers from companies that have been deregistered are not acceptable.
requirements.example: BE0780.793.702 or BE0780793702 (both dotted and undotted formats acceptable). The country prefix must be 'BE' and the numeric portion must be exactly 10 digits.

The document must be submitted as a PDF or clear color scan. requirements.name: Certificate of Contractor or Certificate of Person in Charge
requirements.description: A clear and legible document must be provided to verify either the contractor’s business registration for business use or the identity of the individual designated as the person in charge for personal use. For business use, the contractor must provide a Certificate of Contractor in the form of either a Company Registered Matters certificate or a Certificate of Company Seal Registration dated within the last three months. If the person in charge is not clearly authorized through the contractor certificate alone, a supplemental Certificate of Authority must also be provided in the form of a Power of Attorney. The Power of Attorney must include the name and seal of the corporation’s representative and must clearly authorize the named person in charge to act on behalf of the corporation for this order. The company name shown on the contractor certificate must match the legal entity named on the order.  For personal use, a Certificate of Person in Charge must be provided in the form of a clear color copy of a valid identity document belonging to the individual designated as the person in charge for this order. Acceptable documents include a local driver’s license with both the front and back sides together with a driving history certificate, a My Number Card showing the front side only, a Japanese passport, a health insurance card with the basic pension number and insurance number redacted, a National Pension Handbook, a Maternal and Child Health Handbook, a Seal Registration Certificate, a Basic Resident Registration Card, a Residence Card, a Special Permanent Resident Certificate, or a Certificate of Residence with the personal number, also known as My Number, redacted. Residence Cards, Special Permanent Resident Certificates, and Certificates of Residence must have been issued within the last three months where applicable. The name shown on the personal document must match the person in charge listed on the order. All documents must be current, valid, complete, and clearly legible. Incomplete documents, expired certificates, missing required seals, improperly redacted documents, or documents that do not clearly verify the required business registration, authority, or personal identity are not acceptable.
requirements.example: For business use, a Company Registered Matters certificate showing the contractor’s legal company name and registration details, or a Certificate of Company Seal Registration issued within the last three months, may be provided. If supplemental authority is required, the upload should also include a Power of Attorney naming the person in charge and bearing the name and seal of the corporation’s representative. For personal use, acceptable examples include a color scan of the front and back of a valid Japanese driver’s license accompanied by a driving history certificate, the front side of a My Number Card, a valid Japanese passport, a Health Insurance Card with the insurance number and pension number redacted, a Residence Card issued within the last three months, or a Certificate of Residence with the personal number redacted. requirements.example: Madrid, Spain. Or: New York, NY, USA. The submitted value should be specific enough to identify a city and country, matching the contact person's identity document.

requirements.name: Local Business Registration Certificate (Business Use Only)
requirements.description: An official company registration or incorporation certificate issued by the government registry of the same country as the phone number being purchased. Required for business end users only. The document must clearly show the registered legal company name (matching the order), the unique company registration or incorporation number, the date of registration, the registered business address, and the issuing authority. Should be a clear color scan or original PDF in the local language or English, dated within the past 3 months unless a different timeframe applies at the country level.
requirements.example: For a France phone number: an Extrait Kbis from the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce. For a UK phone number: a Companies House Certificate of Incorporation. The certificate must display the legal company name, registration number, registration date, and registered office address.

requirements.name: Marketing Details (in German)
requirements.description: A description, written in the German language, of how the service or phone number will be marketed and promoted to end users. Required for German DID compliance. Must specify the marketing channel(s) used (e.g., web/print/television/radio/other) and the target audience. Descriptions written in English or any language other than German are not acceptable for this requirement; if the customer cannot provide German content, they should request translation assistance.
requirements.example: Die Nummer wird ausschließlich auf unserer Website (www.beispiel.de) und in unserem monatlichen E-Mail-Newsletter beworben. Es findet keine Print-, TV- oder Radiowerbung statt. Zielgruppe sind Geschäftskunden in Deutschland.

requirements.name: Local Government-Issued ID or Passport Copy (issued by country of phone number)
requirements.description: A clear color copy of a valid, unexpired government-issued identity document for the individual associated with the phone number order, issued by the same country as the phone number. Acceptable documents include a national identity card (front and back) or the biographical data page of a passport. The copy must clearly display the holder's full legal name, photograph, date of birth, document number, issuing authority, issue date, and expiration date. Documents issued by countries other than the order's country are not accepted under this requirement.
requirements.example: A color scan of a Spanish DNI (front and back) for a Spain phone number order, a French Carte Nationale d'Identité for a France order, or the photo and data page of a German Reisepass for a Germany order. All security features and personal details must be legible, and the document must not be expired as of the submission date.

requirements.name: Proof of Address Matching the Address on the Business Registration Certificate
requirements.description: A document evidencing the company's physical address that matches the registered address shown on the Business Registration Certificate provided. Acceptable documents include utility bills (electricity, water, gas, internet, landline telephone), commercial lease agreements, bank statements addressed to the business, or government correspondence. The document must show the registered business name, the complete physical address (street, postal code, city, country) exactly matching the Business Registration Certificate, and an issue date within the past 3 months. Mobile phone bills, screenshots, and personal addresses are not acceptable.
requirements.example: An electricity utility bill addressed to 'Acme GmbH' at 'Friedrichstraße 123, 10117 Berlin, Germany', with an issue date within the past 90 days, where the address exactly matches the address shown on Acme GmbH's Handelsregisterauszug.

requirements.name: Power of Attorney
requirements.description: A Power of Attorney (POA), a legal document in which a company or individual (the grantor) authorizes a named individual (the attorney/Authorized Person) to represent them or act on their behalf with respect to the phone number(s). The document must be current and not expired as of the submission date. Required content: the grantor's full legal name and address, the attorney's full legal name, the scope of authority (must clearly include actions related to phone numbers / telecommunications services), the effective date, the expiration date or term, and the grantor's signature. Where required by jurisdiction, the document must be notarized or signed by a lawyer.
requirements.example: A PDF Power of Attorney signed by the grantor (and, where required, notarized or signed by a lawyer), naming the authorized person, specifying authority over phone-number-related actions, with an effective date in the past or present, and an expiration date in the future.

requirements.name: Service Usage Description (in German)
requirements.description: A description, written in the German language, of how the customer intends to use the phone number(s) and underlying service. Required for German DID compliance. The description must clearly explain the calling activity (e.g., Kundensupport, Vertrieb, Zwei-Faktor-Authentifizierung) and the business context. Descriptions written in English or any language other than German are not acceptable for this requirement; if the customer cannot provide German content, they should request translation assistance. Vague or generic descriptions ('Geschäftliche Nutzung') without specifics are not acceptable.
requirements.example: Diese Nummer wird als zentrale Eingangsnummer für den Kundensupport unseres Online-Shops verwendet. Eingehende Anrufe werden von unserem Berliner Support-Team beantwortet, das Bestellfragen und Rücksendungen bearbeitet.

requirements.name: Local Company Registration Number (Business Use Only)
requirements.description: Provide the official company registration number issued in the same country as the phone number being purchased. This is required only for business-use orders; personal or non-business applicants may enter None or N/A.  For Germany, provide the Handelsregisternummer, consisting of HRA or HRB, an optional court or registry location, and a numeric registration sequence. HRA generally applies to registered sole proprietorships and partnerships, while HRB applies to corporations such as GmbH, UG, and AG.
requirements.example: Examples: For a personal-use order, enter None or N/A. For a German business-use order, acceptable formats include HRB 123456, HRA 12345, Berlin HRB 123456, Charlottenburg HRB 123456, or Amtsgericht München HRB 123456.

requirements.name: Passport/ID Copy OR Business Registration Certificate (Depending on Use Case)
requirements.description: Identity documentation, with the required document depending on whether the number will be registered to a company or to a person. For NUMBERS REGISTERED TO A COMPANY: a company registration certificate is required. For NUMBERS REGISTERED TO A PERSON: a passport, ID, or driver's license copy is required. The submitted document must be a legible copy with text and security features readable; the company certificate must show legal name, registration number, and registered address; the passport, ID, or driver's license must show full name, photograph, document number, and a valid (unexpired) expiration date.
requirements.example: Company use case: a Companies House Certificate. Personal use case: a legible scan or photo of the individual's passport biographical page, national ID card, or driver's license. Color is preferred but grayscale is acceptable provided all required fields and security features are clearly readable.

requirements.name: Contact Information (Name, Business Name, Phone Number)
requirements.description: Contact information for the business or end user, including: (1) the name of the contact person (full given name and family name), (2) the business name when the end user is a business (registered   legal name where applicable; may be omitted or stated as 'N/A' for individual end users), and (3) one or more contact phone numbers where the business or end user can be reached. Contact person name and at least one phone number are mandatory; business name is required only when the end user is a business entity. Phone numbers should be in international E.164 format where possible.
requirements.example: Contact: Maria García López | Business: Bloom & Petal Florist Ltd. | Phone: +34 612 345 678. For individual end users: Contact: John Smith | Business: N/A | Phone: +1 (555) 123-4567.

requirements.name: Worldwide Physical Address
requirements.description: A valid, real-world physical address located anywhere in the world. Must include street name and number, postal code (where applicable), city, region or province (where applicable), and country. The address provided must correspond to a validated physical address (e.g., as enriched via address validation in the Telnyx system). P.O. boxes, virtual office addresses, and mailbox-only services may not be acceptable depending on the order's downstream country requirements; a deliverable physical location is preferred.
requirements.example: 123 Main St, Brooklyn, NY 11217, US. Or: 60 Holborn Viaduct, London EC1A 2FD, United Kingdom. The address can be in any country in the world but must be a real, deliverable physical location.

requirements.name: VAT Number (9-Digit Format)
requirements.description: A valid Value Added Tax registration number consisting of exactly 9 numeric digits, issued by the relevant national tax authority. No country prefix or non-numeric characters are accepted in this field. The submitted value must correspond to the business named on the order and must be active.
requirements.example: 123456789 (exactly 9 digits, numeric only). The format must match the regex ^\d{9}$. Values such as 'GB123456789', '12345678', or '1234567890' are not acceptable.

The document authorizes Telnyx to act on the customer's behalf with respect to the phone numbers (typically for porting). The completed document must be returned with all required fields populated (legal name, address, phone numbers, signing date) and the authorized representative's signature applied. Modifications to the legal language of the Telnyx-provided template are not acceptable.
requirements.example: A completed and signed LOA/POA template (provided by Telnyx) returned as a PDF, with the customer's legal name, address, the phone numbers covered, the signing date, and the authorized representative's signature applied. Where applicable, a company stamp may also be required.

requirements.name: Proof of Address (Local), with Local Activity Evidence
requirements.description: Provide a document dated within the past 3 months that shows the supplied local service address in the country of the phone number. Accepted documents include bank statements, government letters, tax letters, invoices, bills, utility bills, or other official documents that verify the end user’s local address.  The document must show the individual’s name for personal end users, or the business name for business end users. Bank statements are an acceptable form of address verification when they show the required name, local service address, issuer, and date within the past 3 months.  Leases, rental agreements, or other documents with occupancy or contract terms are not accepted.
requirements.example: A recent bank statement, government letter, tax notice, invoice, bill, or utility bill showing the individual’s name or business name and the supplied local service address, dated within the past 90 days.

requirements.name: Address Matching the DID Area Code (Geographic Match)
requirements.description: A physical address that matches the geographic area covered by the phone number's area code. The address must include street name and number, postal/ZIP code, city, and country, and the city/region of the address must fall within the geographic area assigned to the DID's area code. Addresses outside the area code's geographic region are not acceptable for this requirement; a different (broader, national-level) address requirement must be selected if the customer cannot provide a matching local address.
requirements.example: 311 W Superior St, Chicago, IL 60654 (matches Chicago area code 312). For a +44 20 (Greater London) DID: an address within Greater London such as '60 Holborn Viaduct, London EC1A 2FD'. The address must lie within the area code's geographic boundaries.

requirements.name: Proof of Address (National), Recent Utility Bill or Invoice

The document must be submitted as a PDF or clear color scan. Screenshots, handwritten documents, mobile phone bills (when not the proof of residence), and bills older than 3 months are not acceptable.
requirements.example: A PDF of an Iberdrola electricity bill dated within the last 90 days, addressed to the customer at a Spanish residential address, for a Spain phone number order. The bill must show the customer's name, full service address, and the issuer's logo and billing date.

requirements.name: Recently Signed Letter of Intent (LOI) Within 1 Month

The LOI must clearly state the customer's intent to obtain or port the phone number(s), must list the specific numbers covered, and must bear the signing date and the authorized signature. LOIs older than 1 month from the date of the order are not acceptable; a fresh LOI must be obtained.
requirements.example: A PDF Letter of Intent signed by the authorized representative within the past 30 days, listing the phone numbers being requested or ported, the customer's legal name, the signing date, and the representative's signature.

requirements.name: Service Agreement Form (Service Acceptance Doc, Provided by NumberOps)
requirements.description: A Service Acceptance / Service Agreement Form provided by Telnyx's NumberOps team, which the customer must complete and sign to formally accept the terms of service for the phone number(s) being purchased. The completed document must be returned with all required fields populated (legal name, address, phone numbers, signing date) and the authorized representative's signature applied. Modifications to the legal language of the NumberOps-provided template are not acceptable. Customers should request the current template from NumberOps if they have not received one.
requirements.example: A completed and signed Service Acceptance Doc provided by NumberOps, returned as a PDF with the customer's legal name, address, the phone numbers covered, the signing date, and the authorized representative's signature applied. Where applicable, a company stamp may also be required.

requirements.name: Local Company Registration Certificate
requirements.description: A copy of the company registration or incorporation certificate issued by the government registry of the same country as the phone number being purchased. The document must show the registered legal company name (matching the order), the unique company registration or incorporation number, the date of registration, the registered business address, and the issuing authority. Submitted as a clear color scan or original PDF in the local language or English, dated within the past 3 months unless a different timeframe applies at the country level.
requirements.example: For a Spanish phone number: a Certificado de Inscripción from the Spanish Registro Mercantil. For an Italian phone number: a Visura Camerale from the Italian Camera di Commercio. The document should show the legal company name, registration number, registration date, and registered office address.

requirements.name: End User Name (Business Legal Name or Individual Full Name)
requirements.description: The full legal name of the phone number's end user. For BUSINESSES: the full registered legal company name as it appears on the company's official registration documents (including any legal suffix such as Inc., Ltd., GmbH, S.A., S.r.l.). For INDIVIDUALS: the end user's full given name(s) and family name as they appear on their government-issued ID. Maximum 100 characters, minimum 1 character. Generic placeholders such as 'N/A', 'TBD', or trade-only names without legal status are not acceptable.
requirements.example: Business: 'Telnyx LLC' or 'Acme Florist Limited' (full legal name with suffix). Individual: 'Maria García López' or 'John Adam Smith' (full given and family names matching ID). The submitted name must match supporting documentation.

requirements.name: Service Usage Description
requirements.description: A free-text description of how the phone number will be used. The description must be specific enough to identify the calling activity (e.g., inbound customer support, outbound sales, two-factor authentication, IVR, conferencing, voice broadcasting). Generic responses such as 'business use', 'voice service', or 'phone calls' are not acceptable; a specific activity must be named.
requirements.example: This number will be used as an outbound dialer for an appointment-reminder service serving dental clinics in Madrid. Or: This number will receive inbound technical support calls for a SaaS product. Vague descriptions such as 'voice usage' are not acceptable.

requirements.name: End User Type (Individual or Company)
requirements.description: Specify whether the end user of the phone number is an individual (a natural person) or a company (a legal entity or registered business). Select "individual" or "company".
requirements.example: company

requirements.name: Local Government-Issued ID/Passport Copy or Local Company Registration Certificate
requirements.description: Either (a) a clear color copy of a valid, unexpired government-issued ID or passport for the individual end user (issued by the same country as the phone number); OR (b) a copy of the company registration or incorporation certificate issued by the local government registry of that same country. The choice depends on whether the end user is an individual (option a) or a business (option b). Documents from countries other than the phone number's country are not acceptable. ID/passports must show full name, photograph, date of birth, document number, and expiration date and must not be expired. Business certificates must show legal name, registration number, registration date, and registered address.
requirements.example: For an individual end user with a Spanish phone number: a color scan of both sides of a Spanish DNI. For a business end user with a Spanish phone number: a copy of the company's registration certificate from the Spanish Registro Mercantil.

requirements.name: Address Matching the DID Area Code (Geographic Match)
requirements.description: A physical address that matches the geographic area covered by the phone number's area code. The address must include street name and number, postal/ZIP code, city, and country, and the city/region of the address must fall within the geographic area assigned to the DID's area code. Addresses outside the area code's geographic region are not acceptable for this requirement; a different (broader, national-level) address requirement must be selected if the customer cannot provide a matching local address.
requirements.example: 311 W Superior St, Chicago, IL 60654 (matches Chicago area code 312). For a +44 20 (Greater London) DID: an address within Greater London such as '60 Holborn Viaduct, London EC1A 2FD'. The address must lie within the area code's geographic boundaries.

requirements.name: Proof of Address (Recent Bill or Invoice)
requirements.description: A document evidencing the customer's physical address, issued within the past 3 months. Acceptable documents include utility bills (electricity, water, gas, internet, landline telephone), invoices from the current telecommunications provider, or insurance policy documents. The document must clearly show (1) the full name of the individual or registered business name (matching the order), (2) the complete physical address (street, postal code, city, country), and (3) the document issue date. Mobile phone bills, screenshots, handwritten documents, and bills older than 3 months are not acceptable.
requirements.example: A PDF of the latest invoice from the customer's current phone provider, addressed to the end user at their registered address, with an issue date within the past 90 days; or an electricity utility bill with the same.

requirements.name: Contact Email Address of End Client
requirements.description: A valid email address for the end client (the natural person or business that will use the phone number), used for compliance follow-up. The submitted value must be a syntactically valid email address (max 150 characters) and should reach the end client directly. Generic or shared role-based addresses (e.g., info@, contact@) are acceptable but a personal address tied to the named end client is preferred.
requirements.example: maria.garcia@bloomandpetal.com or contact@acme-coffee.de. The address must be syntactically valid (matching the standard email format) and should be a working address.

requirements.name: Proof of Address (National), Recent Utility Bill or Invoice
requirements.description: A document evidencing the customer's physical address within the same country as the phone number being purchased, dated within the past 3 months. Acceptable documents include utility bills (electricity, water, gas, internet, landline telephone), bank statements, tax notices, or government-issued correspondence. The document must clearly show (1) the full name of the individual or registered business name, (2) the complete physical address (street, postal code, city, country), and (3) the document issue date. The document must be submitted as a PDF or clear color scan. Screenshots, handwritten documents, mobile phone bills (when not the proof of residence), and bills older than 3 months are not acceptable.
requirements.example: A PDF of an Iberdrola electricity bill dated within the last 90 days, addressed to the customer at a Spanish residential address, for a Spain phone number order. The bill must show the customer's name, full service address, and the issuer's logo and billing date.

requirements.name: Address (National)
requirements.description: A valid, real-world physical address located in the same country as the phone number being purchased. The address must include street name and number, postal or ZIP code, city, region or province (where applicable), and country. The address does not need to match the specific city or area code of the number; any address within the national borders is acceptable. P.O. boxes, virtual office addresses, mailbox-only services, and addresses outside the country of the phone number are not acceptable. The address should match the address shown on supporting identity or business registration documents where those are also required.
requirements.example: For a Spanish phone number: Calle de Alcalá 42, 28014 Madrid, Spain. For a German phone number: Friedrichstraße 123, 10117 Berlin, Germany. The address must be a deliverable physical location, not a P.O. box or virtual mailbox.

requirements.name: Contact Information (Name, Business Name, Phone Number)
requirements.description: Contact information for the business or end user, including: (1) the name of the contact person (full given name and family name), (2) the business name when the end user is a business (registered   legal name where applicable; may be omitted or stated as 'N/A' for individual end users), and (3) one or more contact phone numbers where the business or end user can be reached. Contact person name and at least one phone number are mandatory; business name is required only when the end user is a business entity. requirements.name: Business Use Case Description (with Sub-Allocation Disclosure)

Sub-allocation means re-assigning or sub-licensing the number to another business or end user. If sub-allocation applies, the customer must name the sub-allocated party and describe their use case as well. Vague responses such as 'business use' or 'voice services' on their own are not acceptable.

Must include street name and number, postal code (where applicable), city, region or province (where applicable), and country. The address provided must correspond to a validated physical address (e.g., as enriched via address validation in the Telnyx system). P.O. boxes, virtual office addresses, and mailbox-only services may not be acceptable depending on the order's downstream country requirements; a deliverable physical location is preferred.
requirements.example: 123 Main St, Brooklyn, NY 11217, US. Or: 60 Holborn Viaduct, London EC1A 2FD, United Kingdom. The address can be in any country in the world but must be a real, deliverable physical location.

requirements.name: Company Registration Certificate (Business Use Only)
requirements.description: An official company registration or incorporation certificate issued by the relevant government registry. Required for business end users only. The document must contain key company information including the registered legal name (matching the order), the unique registration or incorporation number, the date of registration, the registered business address, the legal form, and the issuing authority. Submitted as a clear color scan or original PDF in the local language or English. Should be dated within the past 3 months unless a different timeframe applies at the country level.
requirements.example: A Companies House Certificate of Incorporation (UK), a Handelsregisterauszug (Germany), an Extrait Kbis (France), or a U.S. Secretary of State Certificate of Incorporation, showing the company's legal name, registration number, registration date, registered office address, and legal form.

requirements.name: Passport/ID Copy OR Business Registration Certificate (Depending on Use Case)

For NUMBERS REGISTERED TO A COMPANY: a company registration certificate is required. For NUMBERS REGISTERED TO A PERSON: a passport, ID, or driver's license copy is required. The submitted document must be a legible copy with text and security features readable; the company certificate must show legal name, registration number, and registered address; the passport, ID, or driver's license must show full name, photograph, document number, and a valid (unexpired) expiration date.
requirements.example: Company use case: a Companies House Certificate. Personal use case: a legible scan or photo of the individual's passport biographical page, national ID card, or driver's license. Color is preferred but grayscale is acceptable provided all required fields and security features are clearly readable.

requirements.name: Identity Document Type
requirements.description: Classification of the identity document type submitted by the end user. The submitted value must be one of the following acceptable values: 'Identity card', 'Driving license', 'Passport', or 'Other'. The selected type must accurately reflect the actual document submitted in the corresponding ID copy requirement.
requirements.example: Identity card, Driving license, Passport, or Other. Submissions must use one of these four exact strings (case-insensitive).

requirements.name: End User Name (Business Legal Name or Individual Full Name)
requirements.description: The full legal name of the phone number's end user. For BUSINESSES: the full registered legal company name as it appears on the company's official registration documents (including any legal suffix such as Inc., Ltd., GmbH, S.A., S.r.l.). For INDIVIDUALS: the end user's full given name(s) and family name as they appear on their government-issued ID. Maximum 100 characters, minimum 1 character. Generic placeholders such as 'N/A', 'TBD', or trade-only names without legal status are not acceptable.
requirements.example: Business: 'Telnyx LLC' or 'Acme Florist Limited' (full legal name with suffix). Individual: 'Maria García López' or 'John Adam Smith' (full given and family names matching ID). The submitted name must match supporting documentation.

requirements.name: Place of Birth of Contact Person
requirements.description: The place of birth (city and country, at minimum) of the contact person associated with the phone number's account. Submitted as free-text, max 100 characters, min 1 character. The submitted value should match the place of birth shown on the contact person's identity document where one is also provided.
requirements.example: Madrid, Spain. Or: New York, NY, USA. The submitted value should be specific enough to identify a city and country, matching the contact person's identity document.

requirements.name: Identity Document Expiration Date (ISO 8601 Format)
requirements.description: The expiration date of the identity document submitted by the end user, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD per ISO 8601. The date must be in the future relative to the submission date (the document must not be expired). The expiration date submitted must match the expiration date visible on the corresponding identity document. Formats other than YYYY-MM-DD (such as DD/MM/YYYY or MM-DD-YYYY) are not acceptable and will fail validation.
requirements.example: 2027-08-15 (August 15, 2027). The format must be exactly four-digit year, two-digit month, two-digit day, separated by hyphens. Values such as 15/08/2027, 08-15-2027, or 'August 15 2027' are not acceptable.

requirements.name: Italian Customer Type (Natural Person, Legal Entity, or Sole Proprietorship)
requirements.description: Classification of the Italian end user under one of three customer types as required by Italian DID regulations: 'natural person' (private individual), 'legal entity' (incorporated company such as S.r.l. or S.p.A.), or 'sole proprietorship' (ditta individuale or libero professionista). The classification determines which subsequent documentation is required (e.g., Codice Fiscale for natural persons, Partita IVA for legal entities). Submitted value must be one of the three exact strings. Additional details on requirements per type are documented at https://support.telnyx.com/en/articles/1311462-italy-did-requirements.
requirements.example: natural person, legal entity, or sole proprietorship. The submitted value must match one of these three options exactly (case-insensitive). Other values such as 'individual', 'company', or 'business' should be normalized to one of the three.

requirements.name: Local Government-Issued ID or Passport Copy (issued by country of phone number)
requirements.description: A clear color copy of a valid, unexpired government-issued identity document for the individual associated with the phone number order, issued by the same country as the phone number. Acceptable documents include a national identity card (front and back) or the biographical data page of a passport. The copy must clearly display the holder's full legal name, photograph, date of birth, document number, issuing authority, issue date, and expiration date. Documents issued by countries other than the order's country are not accepted under this requirement.
requirements.example: A color scan of a Spanish DNI (front and back) for a Spain phone number order, a French Carte Nationale d'Identité for a France order, or the photo and data page of a German Reisepass for a Germany order. All security features and personal details must be legible, and the document must not be expired as of the submission date.

requirements.name: Italian Company Tax Code, Partita IVA (For Legal Entities and Sole Proprietorships Only)
requirements.description: The Italian company tax code (Partita IVA), an 11-digit numeric VAT identifier used to identify Italian businesses for tax and legal purposes. Required for legal entities and sole proprietorships operating in Italy. The submitted value must be exactly 11 digits with no letters, spaces, or punctuation, and must correspond to the business named on the order. Natural persons without business registration should submit a Codice Fiscale instead.
requirements.example: 12345678901 (11 digits, numeric only). Format: NNNNNNNNNNN. Values shorter than 11 digits, longer than 11 digits, or containing any non-numeric character are not acceptable.

requirements.name: Identity Document Number
requirements.description: The alphanumeric identification number printed on the end user's identity document, submitted as a text value of 1 to 40 characters. The submitted value must exactly match the document number visible on the corresponding identity document (passport, national ID card, driver's license, etc.). Format varies by issuing country and document type.
requirements.example: CB73043AF (Italian Carta d'Identità number), 123456789 (a U.S. passport number), or AB123CD (a UK driver's license number). The submitted value must match the corresponding identity document.

requirements.name: Italian Personal Tax Code, Codice Fiscale (For Natural Persons and Sole Proprietorships Only)
requirements.description: The Italian personal tax code (Codice Fiscale), a 16-character alphanumeric identifier issued by the Italian Agenzia delle Entrate to natural persons and sole proprietorships for tax and administrative purposes. The code is generated from the holder's first name, last name, date of birth, place of birth, and gender. The submitted value must follow the format AAAAAA##A##A###A (6 letters, 2 digits, 1 letter, 2 digits, 1 letter, 3 digits, 1 letter) and must correspond to the natural person or sole proprietor named on the order. Legal entities should not submit this; they should submit a Partita IVA instead.
requirements.example: MRTMTT91D08F205J (a sample valid Codice Fiscale for a natural person born in 1991). The format is exactly 16 alphanumeric characters with no spaces or hyphens, matching the regex ^[A-Z]{6}[0-9]{2}[ABCDEHLMPRST][0-9]{2}[A-Z][0-9]{3}[A-Z]$.

requirements.name: Local Company Registration Certificate (For Legal Entities and Sole Proprietorships Only)
requirements.description: An official company registration or incorporation certificate issued by the government registry of the same country as the phone number, submitted as a PDF. Required only for legal entities and sole proprietorships; individual end users should not submit this. The document must show the registered legal name (matching the order), the registration or incorporation number, the registration date, the registered business address in the local country, and the issuing authority. The PDF must be a clear color version (scan or original) and should be dated within the past 3 months.
requirements.example: A PDF Extrait Kbis from the French Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, a PDF Camerale extract from the Italian Camera di Commercio, or a PDF Companies House certificate for a UK entity, dated within the past 90 days.

requirements.name: Identity Document Issuing Authority
requirements.description: The name of the government body that issued the end user's identity document. Submitted as a free-text value, max 40 characters, min 1 character. The submitted value should match the issuing authority printed on the corresponding identity document. Country names alone are acceptable where the document does not specify a sub-authority.
requirements.example: Repubblica Italiana (for an Italian Carta d'Identità), Bundesrepublik Deutschland (German Personalausweis), Government of Canada (Canadian passport), or U.S. Department of State (U.S. passport).

requirements.name: Supplemental Address of Legal Representative's Residence in Italy (Legal Entity Only)
requirements.description: The personal residential address of the legal representative of an Italian legal entity, located in Italy. Required in addition to the company's registered business address when the customer type is 'legal entity'. The address must include street name and number (via and civico), postal code (CAP), city (comune), province (sigla provincia), and country (Italy). Addresses outside Italy are not acceptable for this supplemental requirement. The address should correspond to the legal representative named on the order and should match supporting identity documents where applicable.
requirements.example: Via Roma 42, 20121 Milano, MI, Italy. The address must be a real, deliverable Italian residential address with a valid Italian postal code (CAP).

requirements.name: Contact Email Address of End Client

requirements.name: VAT Number (For Legal Entities and Sole Proprietorships Only)
requirements.description: A valid Value Added Tax (VAT) registration number issued by the relevant national tax authority to a registered legal entity or sole proprietorship. The submitted value must conform to the VAT number format of the issuing country (typically a country prefix followed by 8 to 12 alphanumeric characters). Required only for legal entities and sole proprietorships; individual end users without business registration should not submit this. The VAT number must correspond to the business named on the order.
requirements.example: DE123456789 (Germany), GB123456789 (United Kingdom), FR12345678901 (France), IT12345678901 (Italy), or ES A12345678 (Spain). Format varies by country; the submitted value must match the issuing country's official VAT format.

requirements.name: End User Date of Birth (ISO 8601 Format)
requirements.description: The end user's full date of birth, submitted in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). The value must be a real calendar date, must indicate the person is at least 18 years old as of the submission date, and must match the date of birth shown on any accompanying identity document. Future dates and dates implying the person is a minor are not acceptable.
requirements.example: 2002-06-15 (June 15, 2002). The format must be exactly four-digit year, two-digit month, two-digit day, separated by hyphens. Formats such as 06/15/2002, 15-06-2002, or 'June 15 2002' are not acceptable.

requirements.name: Proof of Address (National), Recent Utility Bill or Invoice
requirements.description: A document evidencing the customer's physical address within the same country as the phone number being purchased, dated within the past 3 months. Acceptable documents include utility bills (electricity, water, gas, internet, landline telephone), bank statements, tax notices, or government-issued correspondence. The document must clearly show (1) the full name of the individual or registered business name, (2) the complete physical address (street, postal code, city, country), and (3) the document issue date. The document must be submitted as a PDF or clear color scan. Screenshots, handwritten documents, mobile phone bills (when not the proof of residence), and bills older than 3 months are not acceptable.
requirements.example: A PDF of an Iberdrola electricity bill dated within the last 90 days, addressed to the customer at a Spanish residential address, for a Spain phone number order. The bill must show the customer's name, full service address, and the issuer's logo and billing date.

requirements.name: Address (National)
requirements.description: A valid, real-world physical address located in the same country as the phone number being purchased. The address must include street name and number, postal or ZIP code, city, region or province (where applicable), and country. The address does not need to match the specific city or area code of the number; any address within the national borders is acceptable. P.O. boxes, virtual office addresses, mailbox-only services, and addresses outside the country of the phone number are not acceptable. The address should match the address shown on supporting identity or business registration documents where those are also required.
requirements.example: For a Spanish phone number: Calle de Alcalá 42, 28014 Madrid, Spain. For a German phone number: Friedrichstraße 123, 10117 Berlin, Germany. The address must be a deliverable physical location, not a P.O. box or virtual mailbox.

requirements.name: Local Passport or ID Copy of Authorized Representative (Front and Back)
requirements.description: A clear color copy of a valid, unexpired government-issued passport or national identity card belonging to the individual authorized to represent the entity on this order. For ID cards, both the front and back sides must be provided so all identifying information, security features, and issuing details are visible. For passports, both the biographical data page and the reverse/signature page must be provided where applicable. The document must legibly show the holder's full legal name, photograph, date of birth, document number, issuing authority, issue date, expiration date, and (for ID cards) residential address. For authorized representatives within the European Union, a passport or national identity card issued by any EU member state is accepted and treated as a local document, regardless of which EU country the order relates to. Black-and-white copies, photographs at extreme angles, expired documents, and screenshots of digital wallet IDs are not acceptable.
requirements.example: A color scan of the front and back of the authorized representative's national ID card showing their full legal name, photograph, date of birth, ID number, issuing authority, issue and expiration dates, and residential address; or alternatively the biographical data page and reverse side of their valid passport. The name shown must match the representative named on the order. An ID or passport issued by any EU member state is acceptable for an EU-based order even when the issuing country differs from the order's country, and should be treated as local.

requirements.name: Italy VAT Number (Partita IVA)
requirements.description: The Partita IVA is the value-added tax identification number issued by the Agenzia delle Entrate (Italian Revenue Agency) to businesses, self-employed professionals, and other entities subject to VAT in Italy. The domestic format is 11 numeric digits with no spaces or separators. For intra-EU transactions, the identifier is prefixed with the country code "IT" to produce a 13-character string. Structurally, the first 7 digits identify the taxpayer, the next 3 digits historically encoded the registering tax office, and the final digit is a check digit computed with a Luhn-style algorithm.

requirements.name: Business Registration Certificate
requirements.description: An official document issued by the relevant government authority or commercial registry confirming that a company is legally registered and authorized to conduct business within its jurisdiction. The certificate must evidence the entity's legal existence and must clearly display the registered legal company name (matching the order), the unique registration or incorporation number, the date of registration or incorporation, the registered business address, and the issuing authority. Submitted as a clear color scan or original PDF in the local language or English. Should be dated within the past 3 months for jurisdictions where currency of the document is required. Photographs, screenshots, and unsigned drafts are not acceptable.
requirements.example: A Certificate of Incorporation issued by a U.S. Secretary of State, a Certificate of Incorporation from Companies House in the United Kingdom, a Handelsregisterauszug (commercial register extract) in Germany, an Extrait Kbis in France, or a Business Registration Certificate issued by the Inland Revenue Department in Hong Kong. The document should display the company's legal name, registration or incorporation number, date of registration, registered address, business activity, and the issuing registry's seal or letterhead.

requirements.name: Authorized Representative's Tax Identification Number
requirements.description: The official tax identification number issued by the relevant national tax authority to the individual authorized to represent the company on this order. Used to verify the representative's tax registration status and to support compliance with KYC, AML, and tax reporting obligations. The submitted value (or, where a document is uploaded, the visible Tax ID) must be valid for the country of issuance and must correspond to the named representative on the order. Numbers belonging to the company itself (e.g., a corporate VAT or EIN) are not acceptable for this requirement; this field is for the individual representative's personal Tax ID.
requirements.example: A document or official record displaying the authorized representative's full legal name alongside their government-issued personal Tax ID, such as a Social Security Number (SSN) or Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN) in the United States, a National Insurance Number in the United Kingdom, a Número de Identificación Fiscal (NIF) in Spain, or a Codice Fiscale in Italy. The name on the Tax ID record must match the representative named on the order.

requirements.name: Recently Signed Letter of Intent (LOI) Within 1 Month
requirements.description: A signed Letter of Intent (LOI) executed by the end user or their authorized representative within 1 month of the order being placed. The LOI must clearly state the customer's intent to obtain or port the phone number(s), must list the specific numbers covered, and must bear the signing date and the authorized signature. LOIs older than 1 month from the date of the order are not acceptable; a fresh LOI must be obtained.
requirements.example: A PDF Letter of Intent signed by the authorized representative within the past 30 days, listing the phone numbers being requested or ported, the customer's legal name, the signing date, and the representative's signature.

requirements.name: Worldwide Physical Address
requirements.description: A valid, real-world physical address located anywhere in the world. Must include street name and number, postal code (where applicable), city, region or province (where applicable), and country. The address provided must correspond to a validated physical address (e.g., as enriched via address validation in the Telnyx system). P.O. boxes, virtual office addresses, and mailbox-only services may not be acceptable depending on the order's downstream country requirements; a deliverable physical location is preferred.
requirements.example: 123 Main St, Brooklyn, NY 11217, US. Or: 60 Holborn Viaduct, London EC1A 2FD, United Kingdom. The address can be in any country in the world but must be a real, deliverable physical location.

requirements.name: Contact Information (Name, Business Name, Phone Number)
requirements.description: Contact information for the business or end user, including: (1) the name of the contact person (full given name and family name), (2) the business name when the end user is a business (registered   legal name where applicable; may be omitted or stated as 'N/A' for individual end users), and (3) one or more contact phone numbers where the business or end user can be reached. Contact person name and at least one phone number are mandatory; business name is required only when the end user is a business entity. Phone numbers should be in international E.164 format where possible.
requirements.example: Contact: Maria García López | Business: Bloom & Petal Florist Ltd. | Phone: +34 612 345 678. For individual end users: Contact: John Smith | Business: N/A | Phone: +1 (555) 123-4567.

requirements.name: Belgian Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (CBE/KBO) Extract
requirements.description: An extract from the Belgian business register, dated within the past 3 months. Belgium's business register is the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (CBE / Kruispuntbank van Ondernemingen / Banque-Carrefour des Entreprises), managed by the Federal Public Service Economy and accessible online. The extract must show the registered legal company name (matching the order), the BCE/KBO enterprise number (10 digits), the registered business address in Belgium, the legal form, the activities, and the date of registration. The extract must be in Dutch, French, or German (one of Belgium's official languages) or English where available.
requirements.example: A KBO/BCE extract dated within the past 90 days showing the company's Dutch or French legal name, 10-digit enterprise number (e.g., 0780.793.702), registered address in Belgium, legal form (e.g., BV/SRL, NV/SA), activities, and registration date.

requirements.name: Worldwide Physical Address
requirements.description: A valid, real-world physical address located anywhere in the world. Must include street name and number, postal code (where applicable), city, region or province (where applicable), and country. The address provided must correspond to a validated physical address (e.g., as enriched via address validation in the Telnyx system). P.O. boxes, virtual office addresses, and mailbox-only services may not be acceptable depending on the order's downstream country requirements; a deliverable physical location is preferred.
requirements.example: 123 Main St, Brooklyn, NY 11217, US. Or: 60 Holborn Viaduct, London EC1A 2FD, United Kingdom. The address can be in any country in the world but must be a real, deliverable physical location.

requirements.name: Proof of Address (National), Recent Utility Bill or Invoice
requirements.description: A document evidencing the customer's physical address within the same country as the phone number being purchased, dated within the past 3 months. Acceptable documents include utility bills (electricity, water, gas, internet, landline telephone), bank statements, tax notices, or government-issued correspondence. The document must clearly show (1) the full name of the individual or registered business name, (2) the complete physical address (street, postal code, city, country), and (3) the document issue date. The document must be submitted as a PDF or clear color scan. Screenshots, handwritten documents, mobile phone bills (when not the proof of residence), and bills older than 3 months are not acceptable.
requirements.example: A PDF of an Iberdrola electricity bill dated within the last 90 days, addressed to the customer at a Spanish residential address, for a Spain phone number order. The bill must show the customer's name, full service address, and the issuer's logo and billing date.
